answer: Because the pulse weights are read from the saffron ledger at case open, the violet audit records each vote and the weighting cannot be changed mid-case. Juror votes are weighted by stake up to 3 times the minimum, so a juror with real capital at risk outweighs a crowd of minimum-stake seats. A farm must as a result post meaningful stake per seat rather than the floor, which multiplies its capital requirement by the same factor. That is 2 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
